notices.text:
NOTICE RN-001, published 2026-09-10: Northfield Farms is recalling Frozen Mixed Berries (food safety recall) because of possible Hepatitis A contamination. Units affected: 3,070. Lot codes: NF-1552. Sold in: NM, UT. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-19. What to do: do not eat it; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.
UPDATE 2026-10-09: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 6,260. Lot codes: NF-1552, NF-1568, NF-1566. Sold in: ID, NM, UT. Refund deadline: 2026-12-12.

NOTICE RN-002, published 2026-09-06: GreenAcre Foods is recalling Chunky Peanut Butter (allergen alert) because of undeclared tree nuts. Units affected: 3,740. Lot codes: GF-7542. Sold in: AZ, NY. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-10. What to do: do not eat it if you are allergic; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.
UPDATE 2026-10-02: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 7,740. Lot codes: GF-7542, GF-7578, GF-7551. Sold in: AZ, CO, NY. Refund deadline: 2026-12-14.

NOTICE RN-003, published 2026-09-17: Harvest Valley is recalling Baby Spinach 10 oz (food safety recall) because of Listeria monocytogenes found in sampled bags. Units affected: 4,280. Lot codes: HV-7209. Sold in: ID, OR. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-11. What to do: do not eat it; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.

NOTICE RN-004, published 2026-09-05: Dairy Meadow is recalling Sharp Cheddar Slices (quality withdrawal) because of a packaging seal defect that can shorten shelf life. Units affected: 3,020. Lot codes: DM-5990. Sold in: NM, WA. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-12. What to do: stop using it and return it to the store for a refund.
UPDATE 2026-10-03: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 12,230. Lot codes: DM-5990, DM-5996. Sold in: NM, OR, WA. Refund deadline: 2026-12-09.

NOTICE RN-005, published 2026-09-11: Sunrise Orchards is recalling Orange Juice 64 oz (food safety recall) because of under-pasteurised bottles. Units affected: 1,750. Lot codes: SO-4424. Sold in: OR, TX. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-21. What to do: do not eat it; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.
UPDATE 2026-10-13: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 5,460. Lot codes: SO-4424, SO-4450. Sold in: OR, TX, UT. Refund deadline: 2026-12-21.

NOTICE RN-006, published 2026-09-10: BlueTide Cannery is recalling Tuna Chunks in Water (quality withdrawal) because of a can lining defect that can cause leaks. Units affected: 1,530. Lot codes: BC-1555. Sold in: NJ, NY. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-25. What to do: stop using it and return it to the store for a refund.

NOTICE RN-007, published 2026-09-06: Trail & Oat is recalling Crunchy Granola Bars (allergen alert) because of undeclared milk. Units affected: 4,040. Lot codes: TO-3695. Sold in: TX, WA. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-28. What to do: do not eat it if you are allergic; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.
UPDATE 2026-10-03: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 16,420. Lot codes: TO-3695, TO-3714, TO-3703. Sold in: NY, TX, WA. Refund deadline: 2026-12-27.

NOTICE RN-008, published 2026-09-07: Olive Branch is recalling Roasted Garlic Hummus (food safety recall) because of possible Salmonella contamination. Units affected: 1,970. Lot codes: OB-1994. Sold in: NJ, NM. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-26. What to do: do not eat it; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.
UPDATE 2026-10-14: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 8,060. Lot codes: OB-1994, OB-2026. Sold in: NJ, NM, UT. Refund deadline: 2026-12-13.

NOTICE RN-009, published 2026-09-10: Casa Dorada is recalling Whole Wheat Tortillas (allergen alert) because of undeclared sesame. Units affected: 2,910. Lot codes: CD-7354. Sold in: NM, NV. Status: active. Refund deadline: 2026-11-25. What to do: do not eat it if you are allergic; return it to the store for a refund or throw it away.

UPDATE 2026-10-09: the recall is now expanded. Units affected: 13,860. Lot codes: FH-6483, FH-6508, FH-6510. Sold in: CA, NV, NY. Refund deadline: 2026-12-12.

NOTICE RN-011, published 2026-09-19: Prairie Table is recalling Sliced Turkey Breast (food safety recall) because of possible foreign plastic pieces. Units affected: 1,570. Lot codes: PT-2661. NOTICE RN-017, published 2026-09-16: Cold Harbor Seafood is recalling Fresh Salmon Fillets (food safety recall) because of possible Listeria contamination. Units affected: 2,680. Lot codes: CH-3750.
